speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Hold on. You honestly expect me to believe that social protocol dictates we break our backs helping Wolowitz move, and then he only need buy us a pizza?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I'm sorry, that really is how it works.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're tricking me. You tell me the truth, what do we get?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You get to choose between a mountain bike or a PS3.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Enough with the guilt, ma, we'll still see each other. I'll come over every night and have dinner with you.

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: The hell you will! What am I running here, a fancy restaurant? Does this look like Olive Garden?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Okay, I get it, you're angry. You don't want to see your little bird leave the nest.

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: Little bird? You're almost 30, fly, for god's sake!

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Fine, I'll stay! You happy, crazy lady? I sure as hell hope so, because you're ruining my life!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Hey, Penny, it's Leonard. Good news, you can take your head out of the oven.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I guess I won't be needing this.
